tests.name: documents-the-measured-feature-set
tests.description: Names the coverage job and the exact features it instruments, instead of the inaccurate "default features only"

tests.name: documents-tracing-waiver-class
tests.description: Documents tracing/log field spans as a waiver class

tests.name: documents-unreachable-waiver-class
tests.description: Documents unreachable defensive arms as a waiver class

tests.name: documents-feature-gated-gap
tests.description: Documents feature-gated waiver classes (csm and the Turso features) and the #1045 history

tests.name: distinguishes-patch-status-from-comment
tests.description: Teaches that codecov/patch can be green while its comment warns, so the thread is answered rather than treated as a CI blocker

tests.name: requires-ungated-tests
tests.description: Requires coverable lines to be tested with ungated tests

tests.name: has-reply-template
tests.description: Provides a thread-ready waiver reply template

tests.name: rejects-ci-green-alone
tests.description: Rejects CI-green-alone merging with an unanswered Codecov comment

tests.name: demands-the-ci-coverage-artifact
tests.description: Points at the CI coverage-report artifact (gh run download) as the line-level ground truth, not a local llvm-cov run
tests.exec: rg -q 'gh run download' .agents/skills/coverage-waivers/SKILL.md && rg -q 'coverage-report' .agents/skills/coverage-waivers/SKILL.md && rg -qi 'git diff -U0|patch hunks' .agents/skills/coverage-waivers/SKILL.md

tests.name: bounds-the-local-report
tests.description: States why a package-scoped local coverage report cannot decide triage (whole-workspace instrumentation differs)

tests.name: checks-cfg-not-polarity
tests.description: Warns that cfg(not(feature = ...)) compiles in the measured build, so those lines are coverable

tests.name: documents-destructive-setup-for-error-arms
tests.description: Teaches schema invalidation (DROP TABLE after a write) to reach error arms deterministically before waiving them as unreachable
